summary: Full-stack testing of editable Legal Journal feature at /legal-journal. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed covering auth (login success/failure, /me with/without token), diary CRUD (public GET, protected POST/PUT/DELETE, 401 without auth), photo persistence (base64 data URL + caption), practicum/week filtering, and /api/stats auto-calc (days_logged, memos_drafted, court_attendances, practicum_terms=2). Frontend: End-to-end Playwright flow succeeded — empty state visible for logged-out users, Owner Login modal opens and authenticates alex@journal.com/alex2026, 'Editing as' badge and '+ Add Entry' button appear, entry created with date+title+description+tag, appears as diary card, edit persists new title, delete removes card, week chip and Practicum II tab filter correctly with proper upcoming empty message. All test entries cleaned up — DB left empty as required.

issues: React dev-instrumentation injects <span> inside <option> for the Week/Practicum <select> options, producing a hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Not user-visible, but noisy in dev console. Source code (EntryEditor.jsx line 134) is clean — the wrapper appears to come from the emergent x-source-file instrumentation. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~255 line file — acceptable now, but if more resources are added, split routers (auth, entries, stats) into modules.
seed_admin() properly updates password when it changes (good — matches auth playbook).
Bearer token stored in localStorage (per requirements); server.py also accepts cookie 'access_token' but frontend uses header only — dead code path but harmless.
get_entries has no pagination (to_list(1000) hard cap) — fine for MVP but flag for scale.
MongoDB _id excluded via projection everywhere — good.
No rate limiting / lockout on /api/auth/login — playbook mentions brute force lockout after 5 fails; NOT implemented. Low priority for this MVP but worth noting.
test_credentials: alex@journal.com / alex2026 (seeded automatically on backend startup).
seed_data_creation: None. All TEST_ entries created during tests were cleaned up. Diary left empty per user requirement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -o addopts=''` (root pytest.ini enables xdist which breaks the stats concurrency test; the addopts override forces serial). Frontend route is /legal-journal (NOT root). Auth via Bearer token in localStorage; admin credentials seeded from backend/.env ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD. Any TEST_ prefixed entries should be cleaned up via DELETE /api/entries/{id} after test runs to keep diary empty.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The initial parallel-run stats test failure was a test-isolation artifact (xdist ran TestEntries and TestStats concurrently on different workers), not a backend bug. Rerun serially — all 13 tests pass.
